title: Analysis of the Frequency and Impacts of Flooding in Chad
organization: World Bank Sahel Adaptive Social Protection Program Technical Paper Series; Pierre E. Biscaye (external contributor)
temporal_coverage: Flood incidence analysis over approximately 2012–2024 and modeled present-day exposure under 2020 conditions
methodology: External technical study compares flood-hazard models, survey reports and satellite-detected floods, then maps population exposure using administrative and population datasets.
limitations: Modeled exposure is not observed damage; estimates vary by flood model and population data. Some satellite years are missing and built-up areas can be harder to detect.

title: Chad Economic Update: Improving Resilience to Floods
temporal_coverage: Disaster-risk context and observed events through 2022, with climate-impact projections to 2050 and end-century
methodology: Economic update combining flood-risk context, service data and climate-impact modeling summarized from the Sahel CCDR.
limitations: The report relies partly on cited data; conflict and displacement statements do not evaluate specific flood events causally.

title: FAO GIEWS Country Brief on Chad
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
temporal_coverage: GIEWS reference date 7 September 2026; reports crop conditions through mid-August 2026 and outcomes for the 2025 cereal season.
methodology: FAO GIEWS combines cereal-balance, price, Cadre Harmonisé and satellite crop-monitoring information.
limitations: This dated brief is a snapshot; its 2026 seasonal outlook is not a verified final harvest result.

title: When the Waters Rise: How the City of N’Djamena, Chad, Prepared for Floods and Averted Disaster
temporal_coverage: World Bank results brief on the N’Djamena Urban Resilience Project's 2024 flood-preparedness activities and reported results, published 26 May 2026.
methodology: World Bank results brief describes PILIER activities and reported 2024 results.
limitations: Project results are self-reported; the page provides no counterfactual or independent evaluation of flood losses avoided.

title: Chad Humanitarian Situation Report No. 2 (End of Year), 31 December 2025
temporal_coverage: UNICEF report published 9 February 2026, covering 1 January to 31 December 2025 and summarizing humanitarian needs and response.
limitations: Some OCHA data are relayed; flood data lack household detail.

title: Chad Situation Report #1 – July 2024
temporal_coverage: UNFPA report on the July 2024 humanitarian situation, published August 2024.
methodology: UNFPA operational situation report summarizing reported flood impacts, displacement and service delivery.
limitations: The brief gives no named flood-affected provinces or detailed breakdown of affected women and girls.
